key_phrases: structural increase in underlying semiconductor demand
long-term gross margin of 50% and higher is achievable
capacity to remain tight in 2021 and throughout 2022
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is highly positive, driven by strong revenue growth (12% in USD) and robust demand across all four platforms. Management shows extreme confidence in their technology leadership (N3/N3E) and long-term profitability (50%+ gross margin). Quantitative specificity is high with detailed breakdowns of revenue by technology and platform. While there are mentions of short-term supply chain imbalances and potential inventory corrections, the tone remains optimistic due to structural megatrends. Capex enthusiasm is high, with a $30 billion budget for 2025 and incremental spending for the new Japan fab. Some evasiveness was noted in QA regarding specific competitor roadmaps and precise 2022 pricing/depreciation details, which is typical for TSMC.
